\section[\texorpdfstring{\pa{ਪੇਸ਼ਾ} (peshā)}{ਪੇਸ਼ਾ (peshā)}]{\pa{ਪੇਸ਼ਾ} (peshā) — a profession; a trade}

\label{lesson:PA-C364-pesha}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Punjabi for to set in order, then the Punjabi for a promotion.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \pa{ਪੇਸ਼ਾ}}
\textbf{\pa{ਪੇਸ਼ਾ}} — \emph{peshā} — \textquotedblleft{}a profession; a trade\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\pa{ਪੜ੍ਹਾਉਣਾ} \pa{ਮੇਰਾ} \pa{ਪੇਸ਼ਾ} \pa{ਹੈ।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{paṛhāuṇā merā peshā hai.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Teaching is my profession.
\end{quote}

A masculine noun.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\pa{ਪੇਸ਼ਾ}} (\emph{peshā}) is a loan, usually traced to Persian \emph{pēsha}, \textquotedblleft{}craft\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

One more word for this chapter.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{peshā}, once more

  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Punjabi for to set in order, then the Punjabi for a promotion, then say \emph{peshā} again

\section[\texorpdfstring{\pa{ਜੁੱਟਣਾ} (juṭṭṇā)}{ਜੁੱਟਣਾ (juṭṭṇā)}]{\pa{ਜੁੱਟਣਾ} (juṭṭṇā) — to get down to work; to set to}

\label{lesson:PA-C364-juttna}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Punjabi for successful, then the Punjabi for a certificate.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \pa{ਜੁੱਟਣਾ}}
\textbf{\pa{ਜੁੱਟਣਾ}} — \emph{juṭṭṇā} — \textquotedblleft{}to get down to work; to set to\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\pa{ਮੈਂ} \pa{ਸਵੇਰੇ} \pa{ਛੇ} \pa{ਵਜੇ} \pa{ਕੰਮ} \pa{ਵਿੱਚ} \pa{ਜੁੱਟਦਾ} \pa{ਹਾਂ।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{maiṁ savere chhe vaje kamm vich juṭṭdā hāṁ.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I get down to work at six in the morning.
\end{quote}

Past (I …): \pa{ਮੈਂ} \pa{ਕੰਮ} \pa{ਵਿੱਚ} \pa{ਜੁੱਟਿਆ}, \emph{maiṁ kamm vich juṭṭiā}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\pa{ਜੁੱਟਣਾ}} (\emph{juṭṭṇā}) is inherited from a reconstructed \emph{*yuṭati}, \textquotedblleft{}is joined\textquotedblright{}; CDIAL lists Punjabi \emph{juṛnā}, \textquotedblleft{}to be joined\textquotedblright{}, and Lahnda \emph{juṭaṇ}, \textquotedblleft{}to be joined, be engaged in\textquotedblright{}, under it (CDIAL 10496).
\end{cousinweb}

\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back: from What We Study to Good at My Job}

\label{lesson:PA-R364-review-358-364}



\begin{quote}
Say the Punjabi for a school subject and mathematics.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a school subject, mathematics, science, history, to teach a subject
  \item a lesson to learn, practice, hard work, attention, to put right
  \item an examination, an exam paper, a mark in a test, a result, passed
  \item a college, admission, a degree, a scholarship, a master of an art
  \item capable, skilled, to polish, to carve, to try out
  \item an effort, to put up a building, to carry out a duty, to set in order, a promotion
  \item a profession, a business, successful, a certificate, to get down to work
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A school subject? (\textbf{\pa{ਵਿਸ਼ਾ}}, \emph{vishā}.) Mathematics? (\textbf{\pa{ਗਣਿਤ}}, \emph{gaṇit}.) Science? (\textbf{\pa{ਵਿਗਿਆਨ}}, \emph{vigiān}.) History? (\textbf{\pa{ਇਤਿਹਾਸ}}, \emph{itihās}.) To teach a subject? (\textbf{\pa{ਪੜ੍ਹਾਉਣਾ}}, \emph{paṛhāuṇā}.) A lesson to learn? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਬਕ}}, \emph{sabak}.) Practice? (\textbf{\pa{ਅਭਿਆਸ}}, \emph{abhiās}.) Hard work? (\textbf{\pa{ਮਿਹਨਤ}}, \emph{mihnat}.) Attention? (\textbf{\pa{ਧਿਆਨ}}, \emph{dhiān}.) To put right? (\textbf{\pa{ਸੁਧਾਰਨਾ}}, \emph{sudhārnā}.) An examination? (\textbf{\pa{ਇਮਤਿਹਾਨ}}, \emph{imtihān}.) An exam paper? (\textbf{\pa{ਪੇਪਰ}}, \emph{pepar}.) A mark in a test? (\textbf{\pa{ਅੰਕ}}, \emph{aṅk}.) A result? (\textbf{\pa{ਨਤੀਜਾ}}, \emph{natījā}.) Passed? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਾਸ}}, \emph{pās}.) A college? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਾਲਜ}}, \emph{kālaj}.) Admission? (\textbf{\pa{ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ}}, \emph{dākhlā}.) A degree? (\textbf{\pa{ਡਿਗਰੀ}}, \emph{ḍigrī}.) A scholarship? (\textbf{\pa{ਵਜ਼ੀਫ਼ਾ}}, \emph{vazīfā}.) A master of an art? (\textbf{\pa{ਉਸਤਾਦ}}, \emph{ustād}.) Capable? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਾਬਲ}}, \emph{kābal}.) Skilled? (\textbf{\pa{ਨਿਪੁੰਨ}}, \emph{nipunn}.) To polish? (\textbf{\pa{ਚਮਕਾਉਣਾ}}, \emph{chamkāuṇā}.) To carve? (\textbf{\pa{ਤਰਾਸ਼ਣਾ}}, \emph{tarāshṇā}.) To try out? (\textbf{\pa{ਅਜ਼ਮਾਉਣਾ}}, \emph{azmāuṇā}.) An effort? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੋਸ਼ਿਸ਼}}, \emph{koshish}.) To put up a building? (\textbf{\pa{ਉਸਾਰਨਾ}}, \emph{usārnā}.) To carry out a duty? (\textbf{\pa{ਨਿਭਾਉਣਾ}}, \emph{nibhāuṇā}.) To set in order? (\textbf{\pa{ਸੰਵਾਰਨਾ}}, \emph{saṁvārnā}.) A promotion? (\textbf{\pa{ਤਰੱਕੀ}}, \emph{tarakkī}.) A profession? (\textbf{\pa{ਪੇਸ਼ਾ}}, \emph{peshā}.) A business? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਾਰੋਬਾਰ}}, \emph{kārobār}.) Successful? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਾਮਯਾਬ}}, \emph{kāmyāb}.) A certificate? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਨਦ}}, \emph{sanad}.) To get down to work? (\textbf{\pa{ਜੁੱਟਣਾ}}, \emph{juṭṭṇā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
